name: Fuamnach

attributes.attribute: the jealous druid wife of Midir
poisoned Etain and turned her small

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fuamnach is an Irish heroine and a sorceress. She wed the fairy ruler Midir as his jealous wife. When Midir wished to set her aside for the beauty Étain, she lashed out. From her foster father she got a poison and gave it to Étain. Étain turned into a worm. One telling names her a butterfly, another makes her into a crawling or flying insect. The woman shook a rowan bough and made the beauty into a puddle, then a fly. A second wave raised a wind and sent that fly far away. Her scheme failed. Midir searched for Étain after her rebirth and carried her home.

okr.objective: Fuamnach is the jealous druid wife who hurt Etain.
key_results: Fuamnach was a druid and the wife of Midir.
She poisoned and changed the lovely Etain.
Etain was called a butterfly or a worm.
Midair brought Etain back in the end.
